cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.

mechanism: A claims authority to reject an apology that addresses cancellation instead of concealment.
confusable: Unlike demanding the party occur, A permits cancellation but insists B acknowledge the cost of not telling A.
comparison: A wasted arrival with cake differs from consent to a rescue dog based on omitted information.
seedUse: The seed's demanded apology wording and rejected first attempt already make A judge and direct B's response.
